column2: Cancel and apply for a fresh HFE letter (i.e. complete Step 1 - Check Preliminary HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) and Step 2 - Apply for HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter of the buying process again) by logging in to the HDB Flat Portal .

column2: Please write to us via MyRequest@HDB with your HFE reference number and sales registration number (for new flat) or resale case number (for resale flat).
